newsitem.title: USA: Budget sees Team sale closing in March.
newsitem.headline: Budget sees Team sale closing in March.

text.p: Budget Rent a Car Corp said its sale to Team Rental Group Inc is expected to close in March and it knows of no immediate changes in its operations.
"We're not aware of any changes" in headquarters, staff levels or the status of Budget chairman and chief executive Jack Frazee, said Budget spokeswoman Kimberly Mulcahy.
Lisle, Ill.-based Budget and its licensees employ 25,000 people in 120 countries. Of that total, 7,885 work for Budget itself, with the remainder being licensee employees.
Daytona Beach, Fla.-based Team is buying Budget for about $350 million in cash and securities as Ford Motor Co moves to get out of the rental car business.

"Team bought the company because of the changes that we've made and the direction that it's going ... We believe that they're going to continue to improve Budget's profitability and build on the momentum that we started," Mulcahy said.
Shares in Ford were up 1/2 to 33-3/4, while shares in Team were up 1/2 to 24.
